channel.title: The Grant Desk - Remote, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Remote, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 3 new grants - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Kennan Institute Digital Fellowship 2026-2027
    https://www.kennaninstitute.org/digital-fellowship
    Kennan Institute, Woodrow Wilson International Center for Scholars (supported by the Lounsbery Foundation and the U.S. Russia Foundation) · deadline Closed 14 Aug 2026 · USD 2,000 monthly stipend for the six-month programme, plus mentorship from the Kennan community of experts, six virtual webinars tailored to the cohort, and inclusion in the Kennan alumni network of over 4,500 people. Travel and visa costs are explicitly not covered. No application fee.
  • AIAF Fellowship, Autumn 2026
    https://www.aialignmentfoundation.org/fellowship
    AI Alignment Foundation · deadline Closed 17 Aug 2026 · USD 12,000 stipend paid in two installments, plus a compute budget. Travel covered for in-person Demo Day attendance. No application fee.
  • Good Life Residents Program: AI and Finance
    https://rooseveltinstitute.org/careers/good-life-resident-program/
    Roosevelt Institute, in partnership with Data & Society · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 3,000 stipend, plus travel and accommodation for the culminating event if needed. No application fee.

    https://princint.ai/now-hiring-research-scientists-at-principles-of-intelligence/
    Principles of Intelligence (PrincInt) · deadline Closed 21 Jun 2026 · Estimated salary USD 100,000 to USD 250,000 gross, depending on location and experience. No application fee.

    https://horizonpublicservice.org/applications-open-for-horizons-ai-policy-career-accelerator/
    Horizon Institute for Public Service · deadline Closed 21 Jun 2026 · Up to $100,000 in career-development funding per participant (for unpaid or underpaid placements, courses, conferences, relocation and other career costs), plus 1-on-1 mentorship, dedicated training, application coaching, hiring-manager introductions and exclusive job listings. No application fee.
